content: {"line":"Your gaze anchored on me throughout the ceremony, like roots reaching for iron. Did you long for the Dohkar's surge to draw me nearer to you?","beat":"He moves in, the weathered skin of his arm still radiating heat against the weapon cradled in my hands."}
